requirements.evidence: The code cannot run. app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:52-53 splits the return type as "\\" + newline + "\Illuminate\View\View", which is a parse error. app/Providers/AppServiceProvider.php:28 calls Password::defaults() on the Facades\Password broker (imported at :8), which has no defaults() method, so every boot fails. Login.php:9, Register.php:10 and ResetPasswordController.php:10 import the non-existent Illuminate\Support\Facades\Str and then call Str::lower/transliterate/random. The Auth\* controllers (VerificationNoticeController.php:8, VerificationSendController.php:9, VerificationVerifyController.php:13) extend an unimported `Controller`, which resolves to the non-existent App\Http\Controllers\Auth\Controller. VerificationSendController.php:11 type-hints an unimported `Request`. ResetPasswordController.php:25 uses PasswordFacade::defaults(). Requirements missing from the diff: .env.example (APP_NAME/APP_LOCALE/APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE); the Password::defaults rule (min 8, letters, mixedCase, numbers) is never configured; login does not use redirect()->intended; there is no Livewire layout via #[Layout]; the views use @extends inside the Livewire components.

conventions.evidence: Livewire components call $this->validate([...]) with inline arrays instead of #[Validate] attributes (Login.php:30-34, Register.php:33-38). There are no tests, which breaks the TDD rule. No CHANGELOG or docs updates. Views repeat raw Bulma field markup instead of extracting Blade components. Every Blade view starts with a stray `<?php /* @var \\Illuminate\\View\\View */ ?>` header. Routes use fully qualified class names inline instead of imports (routes/web.php:22-35).

security.evidence: The register rate limiter is ineffective. Register.php:42-55 runs validation before the limiter and calls hit() then clear() on success, so attempts never accumulate. The default password policy (letters, mixed case, numbers) is never configured: AppServiceProvider.php:28 is broken, and even if it worked, `new Rules\Password` sets no complexity rules. Login validates with plain 'email', not a strict e-mail rule (Login.php:31). The logout route sits behind 'verified' (routes/web.php:21-22), so unverified users cannot log out. On the positive side: the verify link checks the logged-in user's id and hash with hash_equals (VerificationVerifyController.php:17-28), the forgot-password response never reveals whether the account exists (ForgotPasswordController.php:24-27), and remember_token is rotated on reset (ResetPasswordController.php:36-39).

tests.evidence: The diff adds no test files. It has no Pest tests for login, register, throttling, the verification tamper case, the 429 response on forgot-password, or localization. The only test-related change is the locale env pins in phpunit.xml:36-37.

simplicity.evidence: AppServiceProvider.php:31-40 defines 'login' and 'register' RateLimiter::for limiters that nothing uses, because the components hand-roll their own keys. Three single-method verification controllers plus a HomeController that only returns a view; route view could do the same. The status flash is rendered both in layouts/app.blade.php:16-18 and in each auth view (e.g. verify-email.blade.php:8-10), so it appears twice.

readability.evidence: Many unused or bogus imports: Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\AuthManager, Illuminate\Foundation\Auth\Guard, Illuminate\Foundation\Support\Facades\Hash, and View/PasswordBroker imported but unused (HomeController.php:5, Login.php:5,11, ForgotPasswordController.php:5,8). Code is not Pint-formatted (`['required','email']`, missing blank lines before return). The return type is split oddly in Login.php:52-53. The views reference the undefined key ui.password_confirmation (reset-password.blade.php:23, register.blade.php:32), and VerificationSendController.php:19 uses the undefined key verification.sent.

scope.evidence: Nearly everything serves the auth task. One unrelated whitespace-only edit to the phpunit.xml root tag (phpunit.xml:6). The unused named rate limiters in AppServiceProvider.php:31-40 are extra.

issues.explanation: The return type `\` followed by a newline and `\Illuminate\View\View` is a PHP parse error, so the Login component cannot load.

Password is imported as the password-broker facade, which has no defaults() method, so app boot throws on every request; `new Rules\Password` without a min argument would also fail, and the rule does not set min 8/letters/mixedCase/numbers.
Illuminate\Support\Facades\Str does not exist, so Str::lower, Str::transliterate and Str::random fatal at runtime.

The Auth namespace controllers extend `Controller` without importing App\Http\Controllers\Controller, so the classes fail to load; VerificationSendController.php:11 also type-hints an unimported Request.
PasswordFacade::defaults() is called on the broker facade instead of Illuminate\Validation\Rules\Password, so password reset always errors.
The change adds no tests at all, which violates the project's mandatory TDD rule and the Livewire unauthorized-call and tamper test requirements.
.env.example is not updated with APP_NAME=PegaFila, APP_LOCALE=pt_BR and APP_FALLBACK_LOCALE=en as the task requires.
The limiter is checked after validation and cleared right after every successful hit, so the register throttle never actually accumulates and limits nothing.
The Livewire full-page component views use @extends/@section instead of a single-root view with a #[Layout] layout, so they will not render correctly as full-page components.
Logout is grouped under the 'verified' middleware, so unverified users cannot log out.
On success the user is redirected straight to home instead of redirect()->intended(route('home')).
E-mail is validated with plain 'email', not strictly (e.g. email:rfc,strict), as the task requires.
Validation uses inline arrays instead of the project's #[Validate] attribute pattern.
The views and controller reference undefined translation keys (ui.password_confirmation, verification.sent), so users would see raw keys.
Docs and CHANGELOG are not updated for the new auth flow.
The named 'login' and 'register' rate limiters are defined but never used.
Several imports are unused or point to classes that do not exist (Foundation\Auth\AuthManager, Foundation\Auth\Guard, Foundation\Support\Facades\Hash).
The layout and each auth view both render the status flash, so it is shown twice.
Unrelated whitespace change to the phpunit root tag.

review.summary: The change sketches session auth with Livewire login/register, password reset, e-mail verification, pt_BR/en ui translations and phpunit locale pins. It cannot run: there is a parse error in Login.php, a broken Password::defaults call in AppServiceProvider that breaks app boot, a non-existent Str facade, and unimported base Controller and Request classes. It also ships no tests, skips .env.example, and has an ineffective register throttle, so it should be rejected.
